name: awesome-handmade-ecommerce-platform
description: Enterprise Monorepo for Awesome Handmade Platform

scripts.dev:client: node init && npm --prefix client run dev
scripts.dev:server: node init && npm --prefix server run dev
scripts.dev:admin: node init && npm --prefix admin run dev
scripts.build:client: node init && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.build:server: node init && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.build:admin: node init && npm --prefix admin run build
scripts.build:all: node init && npm run build:client && npm run build:admin && npm run build:server
